description: This PHP source file defines the Upgrade15 class, which is responsible for performing database upgrade operations related to version 15 of the OpenCart installation process. It handles the migration of manufacturer descriptions, including cloning data across languages and dropping obsolete fields.

classes.name: Upgrade15
classes.description: A controller class in the OpenCart installation process managing the upgrade to version 15, specifically updating manufacturer descriptions across languages.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method executed for the upgrade process. It loads language resources, retrieves manufacturer data, clones manufacturer descriptions for all languages, drops the 'name' field from the manufacturer table, and prepares a JSON response with status and next steps.
